changelog: New voice command "cut last sentence" — say "cut last sentence" alone while dictating (or "শেষ বাক্য কেটে নাও") and the last sentence before the cursor is cut to the clipboard in one step: it leaves the message and is ready to paste anywhere. Before, you had to say "copy last sentence" and then "delete last sentence" separately. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message.
